incident.title: Signal fire in the Canarsie Tube
incident.report: Signal fire in the Canarsie Tube. No L service between Bedford Av and 8 Av in either direction until further notice.

advisory.text: Take the M train from Myrtle-Wyckoff Avs to 14 St/6 Av instead, which takes about 33 minutes and is step-free. Both stations have elevators for your wheelchair.
Take the shuttle bus from Bedford Avenue to Marcy Avenue, then the M and A trains to reach 14th Street-8th Avenue in about 34 minutes. This route includes two transfers and is very crowded.
Take the L train, a shuttle bus, the M, and the 6 train to reach your shift in about 43 minutes. Because of the closure, you must use the shuttle bus between Bedford Avenue and Marcy Avenue.
Take the L train to Broadway Junction, the A train to Fulton Street, and the 4 train to 14 Street-Union Square instead, which takes about 52 minutes. There is no shuttle on this route.

findings.text: Plan PLAN-MVEALSO9 (Bedford Av to Marcy Av with 35 buses/hr and 1 Av to Astor Pl with 30 buses/hr) reduced stranded riders from 4,689 to 623 using 22 buses.
Elevator to the L platform at Myrtle-Wyckoff Avs out of service; M platform elevator works.
Elevator to the L platform at 14 St-Union Sq out of service.
The Jay St-MetroTech to Fulton St shuttle carried 1,560 riders an hour, 93% of plan, using the Brooklyn Bridge bus lane.
The Bedford Av to Marcy Av shuttle carried 1,650 riders an hour, 79% of the 2,100 planned: buses queued on the Williamsburg Bridge approach.
During the L closure, Metropolitan Av/Lorimer St G platform crowding hit the safety limit 26 minutes in; the G needed 2 more trains an hour.

episodes.summary: Tomás: about 52 min, 2 transfers: L Canarsie-Rockaway Pkwy → Broadway Junction (6 stops), then A Broadway Junction → Fulton St (6 stops), then 4 Fulton St → 14 St-Union Sq (2 stops).

Maya: about 43 min, 3 transfers: L Morgan Av → Bedford Av (5 stops), then shuttle bus Bedford Av → Marcy Av, then M Marcy Av → Broadway-Lafayette St/Bleecker St (2 stops), then 6 Broadway-Lafayette St/Bleecker St → 14 St-Union Sq (2 stops). Rides the M between Marcy Av and Broadway-Lafayette St/Bleecker St, running at 102% of capacity: no reasonable route avoids it.

Dev: about 34 min, 2 transfers: shuttle bus Bedford Av → Marcy Av, then M Marcy Av → W 4 St-Wash Sq (3 stops), then A W 4 St-Wash Sq → 14 St/8 Av (1 stop). Rides the M between Marcy Av and W 4 St-Wash Sq, running at 102% of capacity: no reasonable route avoids it.

Aisha: about 33 min, 0 transfers, step-free: M Myrtle-Wyckoff Avs → 14 St/6 Av (11 stops). Rides the M between Myrtle-Wyckoff Avs and 14 St/6 Av, running at 102% of capacity: no reasonable route avoids it.
PLAN-MVEALSO9 published: Bedford-Marcy & 1Av-Astor shuttle plan. The rider desk has the handoff.

Remembered F-MVEALVNSJLB, from INC-MVEALMMM: Plan PLAN-MVEALSO9 (Bedford Av to Marcy Av with 35 buses/hr and 1 Av to Astor Pl with 30 buses/hr) reduced stranded riders from 4,689 to 623 using 22 buses.

PLAN-MVEALSO9: Bedford Av ↔ Marcy Av at 35 buses an hour (2,450 riders); 1 Av ↔ Astor Pl at 30 buses an hour (2,100 riders); 22 buses on the road. Riders with no path 4,689 → 623; max-flow shortfall 1,266 → 315; fastest-path overflow 24,078 → 23,885 riders an hour.

Shuttle candidates: 1 Av → Astor Pl (1,266 riders an hour with no open line, 0.8 km away, line 6); 1 Av → 8 St-NYU (1,266 riders an hour with no open line, 0.9 km away, lines W/R); Bedford Av → Metropolitan Av/Lorimer St (relief for 4,038 riders an hour, 0.7 km away, lines L/G); Bedford Av → Nassau Av (relief for 4,038 riders an hour, 0.9 km away, line G); Metropolitan Av/Lorimer St → Hewes St (relief for 1,643 riders an hour, 0.8 km away, lines M/J).

23,445 displaced riders an hour. If each takes the fastest open path, 4 segments overflow by 24,078 riders an hour: G Greenpoint Av → 21 St at 244%; G Nassau Av → Greenpoint Av at 201%; G 21 St → Court Sq-23 St at 198%; 4,689 have no open path. If riders are spread perfectly (max flow, forward peak direction), the open network can carry 17,167 of 18,432 (93%); 1,266 cannot move. Certificate: the flow is feasible, leaves no augmenting path, and its 17,167 equals the min cut's capacity, so FalkorDB's algo.maxFlow answer stands. The min cut holds no open segment: the open network has spare…

23,445 riders an hour had trips crossing the closure (2,021 origin-destination pairs). Within 1 stop of it: 10,142 riders at 23 stations; within 4 stops: 14,713 at 90 stations; 2,698 more start further out. Largest origin: Bedford Av (4,038).
Opened INC-MVEALMMM. Closed 10 L segments across 6 stations (Bedford Av → 1 Av → 3 Av → 14 St-Union Sq → 14 St/6 Av → 14 St/8 Av). At 8 a.m. the busiest closed segment carried 18,086 riders an hour.

Since Oct 14, 2026: Elevator to the L platform at Myrtle-Wyckoff Avs out of service; M platform elevator works. | Since Jun 12, 2026: The Bedford Av to Marcy Av shuttle carried 1,650 riders an hour, 79% of the 2,100 planned: buses queued on the Williamsburg Bridge approach. | No longer true (Oct 2, 2026 to Oct 9, 2026): Elevator to the L platform at 14 St-Union Sq out of service. | INC-0612 on Jun 12, 2026 (Smoke condition, Canarsie Tube): Bedford Av ↔ Marcy Av planned 2,100, carried 1,650 riders an hour | Playbook "Canarsie Tube closure" used once: Close the L between Bedford Av and 8 Av in…
Resolved: Bedford Av → Bedford Av (L) [120]; 8 Av → 14 St/8 Av (A,C,E,L) [618].

handoffs.note: Plan published. Tell every remembered rider whose trip crosses the closure what to take instead.

playbooks.title: Canarsie Tube closure
steps: Close the L between Bedford Av and 8 Av in both directions.
Measure what the J/M/Z and G can absorb toward Manhattan.
Bridge Bedford Av to Marcy Av with buses sized on the corridor's observed throughput: the June 12 bridge carried 79% of plan.
Add two G trains an hour if Metropolitan Av/Lorimer St is in the min cut.
